summary: VeriGate AI-SDLC v3.2.0 resolves all 7 issues from the live Claude Code trial: Claude PreToolUse returns neutral {} instead of permissionDecision allow, review-findings.json requires substantive summary and reviewed_tree_digest (via stamp-review), git-pre-push enforces Stage 5 review policy when review-findings.json exists, install_verigate.py renders OS-specific python commands into docs and separates --targets ci from azdo-ci, {python} expands to sys.executable in verify commands, harmless chained read-only/VeriGate commands are allowed, stdin=DEVNULL prevents verify hangs, and ASCII [BLOCKED] replaces Unicode crosses on Windows.
